`Ȟ¹ˣ(Γ(U₀ ⊓ U₁)[ε]) →* Ȟ¹ˣ(Γ(U₀ ⊓ U₁))` for the two-chart datum of restriction ring

(`unitsReduction_def`) around `TruncExpCech.cechUnitsReduction`, naming the pinned
two-cover instance once (reducible so that all statements below unify transparently
with the engine's `cechUnitsReduction` spelling). Its kernel is computed from
`H¹(X, 𝒪)` by `h1AddEquivTruncExpCechKernel` below. -/
noncomputable abbrev unitsReduction :
    ((Γ(X, U₀ ⊓ U₁)[ε])ˣ ⧸ cechCoboundaryUnits
        (mapRingHom (X.resHom (inf_le_left : U₀ ⊓ U₁ ≤ U₀)))
        (mapRingHom (X.resHom (inf_le_right : U₀ ⊓ U₁ ≤ U₁)))) →*
      (Γ(X, U₀ ⊓ U₁))ˣ ⧸ cechCoboundaryUnits
        (X.resHom (inf_le_left : U₀ ⊓ U₁ ≤ U₀))
        (X.resHom (inf_le_right : U₀ ⊓ U₁ ≤ U₁)) :=
  cechUnitsReduction (X.resHom (inf_le_left : U₀ ⊓ U₁ ≤ U₀))
    (X.resHom (inf_le_right : U₀ ⊓ U₁ ≤ U₁))

/-- `unitsReduction` is `TruncExpCech.cechUnitsReduction` at the two-cover restriction
datum, definitionally. -/

    unitsReduction X U₀ U₁
      = cechUnitsReduction (X.resHom (inf_le_left : U₀ ⊓ U₁ ≤ U₀))

/-! ## The truncated-exponential kernel classes of overlap sections -/

unit `1 + b ε` in the kernel of the Čech-units reduction, written additively. This is

class `delta s` to `truncExpClass s`. -/

Everything committed and verified. Nine commits; the review landed and I acted on all three of its findings.

## Summary

Closed **two of the three remaining clauses** in Wave 5's T4 block — then discovered, and corrected, that my own claim about what remained was wrong. Nine commits, all sorry-free, root build green at **9164 jobs, exit 0**, axiom probe clean on all four keystones with a control that still reports `sorryAx`.

The honest headline is two-part: the mathematics advanced further than the worksheet predicted, and my accounting of the *residue* was too optimistic twice. Both corrections are in the documents that made the claims.

## Progress

- `Tangent/TwoChartNormalize.lean` (new, 267L, 0 sorries): **(iii-c1)** — every Čech Picard class representable on the two-chart cover is in the comparison's range.
- `Tangent/TwoChartRepresentable.lean` (new, 327L, 0 sorries): **(iii-c2-Zar)** — a class trivial on each chart *is* a two-chart class. No `IsAffine`, no dual numbers, no curve, not even selector surjectivity.
- `informal/w5-t4-worksheet.md`: +§§6.8–6.11, written before every Lean edit as T4 binds; includes three retractions and a start-of-session checklist with the import graph measured acyclic.
- `informal/w5-s-worksheet.md` §2.1: retracted my own "S1 needs an upstream mathlib PR" — `private` hides the name, not the proof.
- Coordination: both threads; flagged a red root build in another lane's file (owner fixed it, since verified green) and a stale-index hazard (two AJC lanes disarmed it); three memories.

The transferable finding: the transport cost both projects had priced — rewrite a cochain's *type*, then `subst` four `Bool` cases — is **zero** if you restrict along an *inequality* instead, because `≤` of opens is a `Prop`. A predicted [M] became [S], and the four-case split vanished from the main lemma.

## Issues

- **I claimed "(iii-c2-aff) alone stands between AJCR and the numeral" twice. Not measured, and wrong.** Two further steps are absent at HEAD: a **carrier translation** (T2 computes Čech H¹ of `DualNumber`-of-*original* sections; the comparison consumes *thickened* sections, and nothing composes the bridge) and the **reduction square** intertwining the two halves. Both bookkeeping, neither landed. I found the square myself via another lane's safeguard; the carrier gap I would not have caught — the reviewer did.
- **Three phantom names in my own docstrings** (`..._surjective_of_mk`, `twoChartClass_surjOn_of_chartTrivial`). Fixed. This is precisely the trap one of my own memories records, and I walked into it while writing the file that cites the lesson.
- Verification note: per a same-day finding that `lean_minimal_hypotheses` can give a false all-clear, I confirmed `hL` load-bearing by **deleting it** and observing failure, not by the tool.
- The janitor never reported (third such background-helper death on this task); filed to human. The work-reviewer *did* report, as an inbox item.

## Why I stopped

**Partly advanced, not complete.** The residue is now correctly stated as three statements: (iii-c2-aff) — the last clause needing geometry — plus the carrier translation and the reduction square. I did not start (iii-c2-aff) because the remaining budget favoured leaving a measured, corrected hand-off over a half-built module. S1 remains a hypothesis by design; **P1 untouched and still DD-gated**, as instructed.

## Next

Take the two bookkeeping steps first — they are cheap, they are now precisely specified in §6.10, and landing them makes (iii-c2-aff) genuinely the last thing. Then (iii-c2-aff) per §6.11, whose step 1 is already struck out (`relCover` supplies the affine thickened cover). Watch the sheaf→module step at clause (i): the sibling project was flagged for eliding exactly that.
